player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Kessling''') posted a [[Light]] [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.

starting.card: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can

description: This is a deck that I along with Adam Drake used at Ramapocon. Charlie Herren also used a similar deck, but his was more superfalcon oriented.
cards: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can
What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?
notes: Starting cards as posted: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Podrace Prep, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and 'YISYW/Don't Do that Again'; they count toward the 60.

The starting line 'YISYW/Don't Do that Again' (one card or the other; the strategy says to start Don't Do That Again against Mobilization Points or Imperial Arrest Order/You Cannot Hide Forever) is kept as written. Both cards are also listed under Effects; with this line the list totals 60 as published.
The strategy says the deck starts the Podrace Arena, which is not in the list.
Don't Do That Again and Ounee Ta are 2001 Effects (not Defensive Shields).

Posted 'Barrier' dested Rebel Barrier (Light); 'Weapon Lev' the Light Jabba's Palace Weapon Levitation; 'Qui-Gons Saber' Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber; 'Push on us' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'Bith Shuffle/DR' The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach; 'Qui God Jinn' Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Naked 3PO' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'EPP Luke/Han/Leia/Obi' the Reflections II EPP characters.
The 'Epic Events' and 'Guys' headers were mis-read as cards and have been dropped.

The poster says he and Adam Drake played this deck at RamapoCon (2001) and he lost only 3 games all weekend (to Charlie Herren, Dominic from Canada and Ed the Michigan state runner-up); he also mentions beating Mike Dalton in the DPC there.
player_note: The poster says he played Test One at RamapoCon and swapped it for the third A Step Backward for the team tournament; the list is posted with the swap.
